description: A ground-level photograph depicting a dry grassland landscape on the Franconian Alb (juniper heathland) in Germany. The foreground shows sparse, light-coloured soil with dry vegetation. The mid-ground features a vibrant expanse of green grassland, interspersed with small yellow and purple flowers, suggesting a spring or early summer scene. In the background, a strip of trees marks the horizon, beyond which lies gently rolling, less vegetated terrain under a clear blue sky. The image was credited to M. Probeck. The surrounding document context indicates this image exemplifies a specific land cover type within a classification system, distinguishing it from categories such as wetlands, heathland and scrub, managed grasslands, or transitional woodland.
